title: Forest fires in Angola

periods.label: Current 24h
periods.source: ECMWF IFS Near-Realtime forecast via Google Earth Engine
periods.temperature_aggregation: 3-hourly trapezoidal time-weighted mean over forecast hours 0-24
periods.vpd_aggregation: SVP(24-hour mean temperature) minus 24-hour mean actual vapour pressure derived from 3-hourly dew-point temperature
periods.precipitation_aggregation: forecast-hour-24 cumulative precipitation minus forecast-hour-0 cumulative precipitation

comparison.precipitation_note: Historical precipitation is the same-calendar-month CRU mean monthly total divided by the mean number of calendar days in that period; Current 24h is the IFS 0-24 h accumulation. Both are shown as mm/day.
comparison.current_note: Current 24h is a model forecast window whose full 24 hours have elapsed, not an observation. The complete-day window is used to reduce diurnal-cycle bias.

scientific_note: Climate comparison provides context and does not establish causal event attribution.
vpd_note: Historical CRU VPD uses monthly-mean temperature and actual vapour pressure; current IFS VPD analogously uses 24-hour mean temperature and 24-hour mean actual vapour pressure derived from 3-hourly dew point.
